t: In front of you, in Parliament Square, stands the statue of Millicent Fawcett, unveiled on the 24th of April 2018. It was the square's first monument to a woman, and its first sculpture by a woman, made by the artist Gillian Wearing. Fawcett led the National Union of Women's Suffrage Societies from 1897 to 1919, and helped found Newnham College, Cambridge. The statue followed a campaign and petition by Caroline Criado Perez, and was funded through the government's Centenary Fund, marking a hundred years since some women won the vote.
